description: Digest-downgrade attempt: the signature is cryptographically valid but covers only ("@method" "@path") — content-digest is omitted from the covered components even though the request has a body. The attacker substitutes the body AND a Content-Digest header that matches the new body, so the §5.3 body-integrity check passes (header and body agree) while the signature still verifies over the components it covers. A conformant v1.6.0 verifier MUST reject per §5.5 component-coverage enforcement: requests with a body MUST have content-digest among the covered components. Verifiers MUST NOT treat §5.3 digest agreement as body authentication — only the signature's coverage of the Content-Digest header binds the body to the signer.

inputs.tampering: The Content-Digest header matches the received body (attacker recomputed it), and the Ed25519 signature is valid over the two components it covers. The only conformant rejection path is the §5.5 component-coverage check.

expected.verifier_behavior: Parse covered components from Signature-Input → request has a body but "content-digest" is not among them → reject with -32001. Do NOT accept based on §5.3 digest agreement plus a valid signature over the covered subset.
